metadata.realization_boundary: Fréchet lower diagnostics concern whether the saved overlap entries themselves are joint-set intersections. They are not inherited LP rows; replacing them by nested maxima requires the known nonnegative-coefficient argument and does not establish SPE.

representation.recipe: histograms: point hist descriptor/weight plus column,old_hist_column,reply_groups,positive_joint_states extras. reply_groups: point hist/current/old/group order, first joint column j has state_columns 01:j,10:j+1,11:j+2, corresponding state_masses copied from point; extras supply ordered_edge_multiplicity,implicit00,R,Z. overlap_records: point overlap column index/hist/groups plus seven values in order overlap,R_masses[0,1],upper_slacks[0,1],frechet_lower_slack,nested_maximum_gap. frechet_lower_violations are exact full overlap_records selected by listed column, not recomputed.
